title: A lane push to a branch held by a ready batch PR is refused, not asked.
ruling: Coordinator choice (time not given; time here is PR 2463's creation, 13:38 CST Nov 9; incident 05:12-05:25 CST Nov 9): "The coordinator chose a refusal, not an ask."
